blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: We introduce SERF (Self-Regularized Flow Language Models), a simple self-supervised framework for improving continuous diffusion language models by exploiting the denoising trajectory itself. While continuous flow-based language models offer a promising alternative to autoregressive generation, their training objectives typically rely on supervision from clean target tokens, leaving the denoising trajectory underexploited as a learning signal. SERF addresses this limitation through noisy-to-clean self-distillation: an exponential moving average (EMA) teacher receives a cleaner version of the student's noisy input along the same interpolation path and provides additional supervision. We investigate two variants: SERF-L, which aligns the student's intermediate representations with deeper teacher representations, and SERF-P, which aligns their output token distributions, either at the student's output or at an early student layer. All variants augment the standard training objective without requiring external pretrained models or modifying the inference procedure. Experiments across three continuous language-model paradigms (one-hot FLM, latent ELF, and hyper-spherical S-FLM) demonstrate substantial improvements in training efficiency, generation quality, and few-step generation. In particular, SERF achieves up to 7.7x wall-clock training acceleration on OpenWebText, improves MAUVE by 24.3% and GSM8K accuracy by up to 28.8%, and matches baseline performance with up to 64x fewer sampling steps. These results establish noisy-to-clean self-distillation as an effective approach to improving continuous diffusion language models.
blocks.zh: 我们引入了SERF(自律流语言模型),这是一个简单的自我监督的框架,通过利用去诺化的轨迹本身来改进持续的传播语言模型. 虽然基于持续流动的语言模式为自动递减生成提供了有希望的替代办法,但其培训目标通常依赖于对清洁目标标志的监督,使去诺能的轨迹得不到充分利用,成为学习信号。 SERF通过高音至清音自沉解决了这一限制:一个指数化的移动平均(EMA)教师在同样的插入路径上得到学生高音输入的更清洁版本,并提供额外的监督. 我们调查了两个变体:SERF-L(将学生的中间代表与更深层次的教师代表相协调)和SERF-P(将学生的输出或早期学生的输出分配相协调). 所有变体都强化了标准培训目标,而不需要外部预先训练的模型或修改推论程序. 跨越三个连续语言模式范式(一热FLM、潜伏的ELF和超球形的S-FLM)的实验表明,培训效率、生成质量和几步生成都有很大提高。 特别是,SERF在OpenWebText上实现了高达7.7x相壁时速的训练加速,将MAUVE提高了24.3%,GSM8K的精度提高了28.8%,并将基线性能与最多64x更少的采样步骤相匹配. 这些结果确立了吵闹到清洁的自我消化,作为改进持续传播语言模型的有效方法.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Current leading language models ( Achiam et al., 2023 ; Anil et al., 2023 ; Guo et al., 2025 ) primarily rely on autoregressive decoding, generating one token at a time. While training benefits from the parallelism of transformer architectures and teacher forcing, inference remains fundamentally sequential, creating a major bottleneck as models and sequence lengths scale. Diffusion language models ( Khanna et al., 2025 ; Nie et al., 2025 ; Sahoo et al., 2024 ) have recently emerged as a promising alternative, offering significantly more flexibility in their generative trajectories. By learning to reverse a corruption process applied to the entire sequences simultaneously, they can generate multiple tokens in parallel and potentially enable substantially faster inference.
blocks.zh: 目前的主要语言模式 (Achiam等人, 2023年;Anil等人, 2023年;Guo等人, 2025年)主要依靠自动解码,一次生成一个令牌. 虽然培训得益于变压器架构和教师强迫的平行性,但推论仍然具有根本的顺序性,形成了一个作为模型和序列长度尺度的重大瓶颈. 传播语言模型(Khanna等人,2025年;Nie等人,2025年;Sahoo等人,2024年)最近已成为一种很有希望的替代方案,在基因轨迹方面提供了更大的灵活性。 通过学习扭转同时适用于整个序列的腐败过程,它们可以同时生成多个符号,并有可能大大加快推论。

blocks.en: While most diffusion language models rely on discrete corruption processes such as masking ( Sahoo et al., 2024 ; Arriola et al., 2025 ) or token replacement ( Schiff et al., 2024 ; Lou et al., 2023 ) , recent work has revisited continuous diffusion and flow-based formulations for language ( Dieleman et al., 2022 ; Lee et al., 2026 ) . Such formulations have been central to advances in image and video generation and provide smooth generative trajectories that support efficient ODE- and SDE-based sampling ( Lipman et al., 2023 ; Song et al., 2021 ) . They are also particularly well-suited to few-step generation, as continuous trajectories can be effectively approximated with a small number of integration steps ( Lee et al., 2026 ; Kang et al., 2025 ) . Importantly, they make techniques developed for continuous generative models directly applicable to language, including guidance ( Ho and Salimans, 2022 ; Karras et al., 2024 ) and flow-based distillation ( Song et al., 2023 ; Boffi et al., 2025 ) . These properties make continuous diffusion a promising and versatile framework for text generation.
blocks.zh: 虽然大多数传播语言模型都依赖于诸如遮掩(Sahoo等人,2024年;Arriola等人,2025年)或象征替代(Schiff等人,2024年;Lou等人,2023年)等离散的腐败过程,但最近的工作重新审视了语言的持续传播和流动配方(Dieleman等人,2022年;Lee等人,2026年)。 此类制剂对于图像和视频生成的进步至关重要,并提供了平滑的基因轨迹,支持高效的ODE和SDE取样(Lipman等人,2023年;Song等人,2021年)。 由于连续的轨迹可以有效地与少量的集成步骤相近(Lee等人,2026年;Kang等人,2025年)。 重要的是,它们使为直接适用于语言的连续基因模型而开发的技术直接适用于语言,包括指导(Ho and Salimans, 2022;Karras等人, 2024)和流基蒸馏(Song等人, 2023;Boffi等人, 2025)。 这些特性使文本生成的一个有希望和多功能的框架得以持续传播。

blocks.en: Interestingly, recent advances in diffusion modeling for image synthesis have shown that augmenting the standard denoising objective with auxiliary self-supervised signals can substantially improve both training efficiency and generation quality ( Yu et al., 2025 ; Kouzelis et al., 2025 ; Chefer et al., 2025 ; Jiang et al., 2025 ) . These methods often involve distilling semantic representations from pretrained encoders ( Yu et al., 2025 ; Kouzelis et al., 2025 ; Wu et al., 2025 ) , but this introduces a dependency on external models whose suitability can be difficult to anticipate, especially in the language domain. More recent methods instead exploit self-supervision within the generative model itself, leveraging the structure of the denoising trajectory to define objectives such as contrastive learning or self-distillation across noise levels and network layers ( Chefer et al., 2025 ; Jiang et al., 2025 ; Haghighi et al., 2025 ) . These results suggest that the denoising process contains rich internal supervision signals that go beyond direct reconstruction of clean data.
blocks.zh: 有趣的是,图像合成传播模型的最近进展表明,用辅助的自我监督信号来增强标准的去诺目标,可大大提高培训效率和生成质量(Yu等人,2025年;Kouzelis等人,2025年;Chefer等人,2025年;Jiang等人,2025年)。 这些方法往往涉及从预先训练的编码器中提炼语义表达(Yu等人,2025年;Kouzelis等人,2025年;Wu等人,2025年),但这引入了对外部模型的依赖性,这些模型的适合性难以预料,特别是在语言领域. 较新的方法则利用基因模型本身的自我监督,利用去Noting轨迹的结构来确定不同噪音水平和网络层之间的对比性学习或自我消化等目标(Chefer等人,2025年;Jiang等人,2025年;Haghhi等人,2025年)。 这些结果表明,除直接重建清洁数据外,去名程序还含有丰富的内部监督信号。

blocks.en: This raises a natural question: can such self-supervised objectives similarly improve continuous diffusion models for language?
blocks.zh: 这就提出了一个自然的问题:这种自我监督的目标能否同样改善语言的持续传播模式?

blocks.en: In this work, we answer this question affirmatively and introduce SERF ( Se lf - R egularized F low Language Models ), a simple and effective training framework that integrates self-supervised learning into continuous flow-matching language models (see Fig. 2 ). We build on Flow Matching Language Models (FLMs) ( Lee et al., 2026 ) , which operate over one-hot token embeddings and are trained to predict the clean one-hot embedding from a noised input using a cross-entropy loss. SERF augments this objective with a noisy-to-clean self-distillation signal derived from the flow trajectory. Given an input sequence, we construct two corrupted versions using the same underlying noise but at different noise levels. The student processes the more corrupted input, while an exponential moving average (EMA) teacher processes a cleaner version along the same interpolation path. Since the teacher solves an easier denoising problem, its representations and predictions provide informative targets for what the student should recover from the noisier input. Matching these targets encourages consistency along the denoising trajectory and provides richer supervision, without modifying the model architecture or inference procedure.
blocks.zh: 在这项工作中,我们肯定地回答了这个问题,并引入了SERF(Se lf - Regulated F 低语言模型),这是一个将自我监督的学习纳入连续流配语言模型的简单有效的培训框架(见图2)。 我们基于流线匹配语言模型(FLMs)(Lee et al.,2026),这些模型在单热符号嵌入上运行,并经过培训,能够通过使用跨线性损失的噪声输入来预测清洁的单热嵌入. SERF通过流轨产生的响亮至干净的自沉信号来增强这一目标. 鉴于一个输入序列,我们用相同的深层噪声构建两个腐烂的版本,但噪声级别不同. 学生处理更腐烂的输入,而指数化的移动平均(EMA)教师处理一个更清洁的版本,沿着同样的插值路径. 由于教师解决了一个比较容易的解密问题,其表述和预测为学生从知音输入中恢复的内容提供了信息性目标. 与这些目标相匹配会鼓励在去名轨迹上的一致性,并提供更丰富的监督,而不修改模型架构或推论程序.

blocks.en:
Inspired by self-distillation approaches in image diffusion ( Chefer et al., 2025 ; Jiang et al., 2025 ; Haghighi et al., 2025 ) , we study two instantiations of SERF . Following these prior works, Latent Distillation ( SERF-L ) aligns intermediate hidden representations, matching the student’s features at a shallow block to the teacher’s features at a deeper block through a lightweight projection head. This encourages the student’s early layers to form the contextual representations that the teacher reaches deeper in the network and from a cleaner input.
Our second variant, Probability Distribution Distillation ( SERF-P ), distills the teacher’s predicted token distribution instead of its features. This target is natural for language, where the denoiser outputs a categorical distribution over the vocabulary at every position. Beyond matching the student’s final output, we also investigate distillation at an early student block: its hidden states pass through a small adapter and the teacher’s frozen output head, and are trained with a cross-entropy loss to match the teacher’s prediction from the cleaner input. Reusing the teacher’s head keeps both distributions in the same output space and encourages the student to recover, already in its early layers, which tokens are plausible given a less corrupted context. This distribution-level target is also closer to the language modeling objective than feature alignment, as it shares the cross-entropy form of the denoising loss. SERF is fully self-contained: all proposed variants derive their supervision from the flow model itself and require no external teacher or pretrained representation model. Moreover, SERF is used only during training and leaves the underlying sampling procedure unchanged, introducing no additional inference-time cost.
blocks.zh:
在图像传播的自我消化方法的启发下(Cefer等人,2025年;Jiang等人,2025年;Haghighi等人,2025年),我们研究了SERF的两个即时性。 继这些之前的作品之后,Latent Distillation(SERF-L)将中间隐含的表达方式进行校对,通过轻量级投影头将学生在浅块的特征与教师在更深块的特征相匹配. 这鼓励学生的早期阶层形成背景的表述,教师通过更清洁的投入深入网络。

blocks.en: To the best of our knowledge, SERF is the first framework to systematically integrate self-supervised objectives into continuous diffusion language models. Our results demonstrate that simple self-distillation along the denoising trajectory can substantially improve training efficiency, generation quality, and few-step generation.
blocks.zh: 就我们所知,SERF是将自我监督的目标系统地纳入持续传播语言模式的第一个框架。 我们的结果显示,沿消毒轨迹简单的自我消毒可以大幅度提高培训效率、生成质量和少步生成。

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: Early approaches to diffusion-based language modeling operate directly in the discrete token space, defining forward processes based on masking ( Sahoo et al., 2024 ; Arriola et al., 2025 ; Nie et al., 2025 ; Chao et al., 2025 ) or random token substitution ( Schiff et al., 2024 ; Lou et al., 2023 ; Sahoo et al., 2025 ) and training models to reverse these corruptions. While theoretically principled, discrete diffusion models face fundamental challenges: tractable inference requires factorized approximations of the reverse process, and the discrete nature of the state space limits the applicability of continuous optimization tools ( Lee et al., 2026 ) . Recent efforts have sought to address these limitations by combining discrete and continuous corruption ( Zhou et al., 2025 ; Zheng et al., 2025 ; Pynadath et al., 2025 ) . In contrast, we operate entirely in a continuous space, avoiding discrete approximations at both training and inference time.
blocks.zh: 早期基于传播的语言建模方法直接在离散符号空间中运行,基于遮掩(Sahoo等人,2024年;Arriola等人,2025年;Nie等人,2025年;Chao等人,2025年)或随机代用符号(Schiff等人,2024年;Lou等人,2023年;Sahoo等人,2025年)定义前进过程,以及扭转这些腐败行为的培训模式. 虽然理论上原则性,但离散扩散模型面临根本性挑战:可牵引推论需要将反向过程的近似化,状态空间的离散性质限制了持续优化工具的适用性(Lee等人,2026年). 最近的努力试图通过将零散和持续的腐败结合起来来解决这些局限性(周等人,2025年;郑等人,2025年;皮纳达特等人,2025年)。 相比之下,我们完全在一个连续的空间中运作,避免在培训和推论时出现离散的近似现象。

blocks.en:
Continuous diffusion and flow matching language models lift tokens into a continuous representation before applying the generative process, enabling the use of standard continuous optimization. The choice of representation varies across methods: learned token embeddings ( Li et al., 2022 ; Gulrajani and Hashimoto, 2023 ; Gong et al., 2022 ; Chen et al., 2026 ) , frozen pretrained embeddings ( Lovelace et al., 2023 ; Strudel et al., 2022 ) , and one-hot vectors ( Lee et al., 2026 ) have all been explored, alongside Riemannian manifold formulations that respect the geometry of the probability simplex ( Jo and Hwang, 2025 ; Cheng et al., 2024 ; Davis et al., 2024 ) .
Our work builds on three continuous flow-based language models. FLM ( Lee et al., 2026 ) operates in the unconstrained Euclidean setting, representing tokens as
one-hot vectors and transporting Gaussian noise to these targets via a
learned velocity field trained with a cross-entropy objective. S-FLM ( Deschenaux and Gulcehre, 2026 ) instead defines the flow on
the unit hypersphere, with token embeddings and hidden states constrained
to 𝕊 d − 1 \mathbb{S}^{d-1} . ELF ( Hu et al., 2026 ) performs flow matching
in a continuous latent space of pretrained T5 sentence embeddings.
We show that SERF applies to all three.
A related line of work has explored few-step sampling via flow map distillation ( Lee et al., 2026 ; Roos et al., 2026 ) , where a teacher model is used to
distill the generative trajectory into fewer sampling steps. While this direction also involves a teacher-student setup, it is orthogonal to ours:
our primary goal is not to reduce the number of sampling steps but to improve the
training objective itself through self-regularization, leaving the inference
procedure entirely unchanged.

blocks.en:
In image generation, a growing body of work has explored augmenting diffusion and flow model
training with self-supervised signals to improve representation quality and
generation performance. One prominent direction leverages pretrained
self-supervised encoders ( Radford et al., 2021 ; Oquab et al., 2024 ; He et al., 2020 ; Assran et al., 2023 ) to align intermediate
diffusion features with rich external visual representations, yielding
substantial gains in training efficiency and sample quality ( Yu et al., 2025 ; Kouzelis et al., 2025 ; Kouzelis et al., 2026 ; Wu et al., 2025 ; Singh et al., 2025 ; Leng et al., 2025 ) . A
complementary set of approaches instead derives supervision entirely from within
the generative model itself, through objectives such as contrastive approaches ( Stoica et al., 2025 ; Wang and He, 2025 ) , or teacher-student
alignment along the denoising trajectory ( Chefer et al., 2025 ; Jiang et al., 2025 ; Haghighi et al., 2025 ) , without relying on an
external encoder. Although methods based on external representations have
generally achieved strong results, Chefer et al. (2025) showed that purely
self-supervised objectives, without external representations, can exceed their performance and scale more favorably across modalities and model
sizes.
Motivated by these findings, we ask whether auxiliary self-supervised objectives can improve continuous flow matching language models.

blocks.en: 3 Method
blocks.zh: 3 方法

blocks.en: In this section, we introduce Self-Regularized Flow Language Models ( SERF ), a training framework that regularizes a flow language model by distilling signals from an EMA teacher evaluated at a cleaner point along the same interpolation path (see Fig. 2 ). We first review continuous one-hot flow matching for language modeling ( Sec. 3.1 ). We then introduce SERF and its two variants, based on latent and probability distribution distillation ( Sec. 3.2 ), before describing the strategies used to select the student and teacher noise levels ( Sec. 3.3 ). Although we instantiate SERF using FLM ( Lee et al., 2026 ) , our framework can in principle be applied to other continuous diffusion or flow-based language models.
blocks.zh: 在本节中,我们介绍了自我规范的流体语言模型(SERF),这是一个培训框架,它通过从同一插座路径上经过更清洁点评估的EMA教师的信号提炼而规范流体语言模型(见图2)。 我们首先审查语言模型的持续一热流匹配(第3.1节)。 然后,我们根据潜在和概率分布蒸馏法(第3.2节),介绍SERF及其两个变体,然后介绍选择学生和教师噪音水平的战略(第3.3节)。 虽然我们利用FLM(Lee等人,2026年)对SERF进行即时分析,但我们的框架原则上可以适用于其他持续传播或流性语言模型。

blocks.en: 4 Experiments
blocks.zh: 4 实验

blocks.en:
To validate SERF , we evaluate its two variants, SERF-L (Latent Distillation, subsubsection 3.2.1 ) and SERF-P (Probability Distribution Distillation, subsubsection 3.2.2 ), on
unconditional language modeling and math reasoning. We apply them to three
baseline models: FLM ( Lee et al., 2026 ) , S-FLM ( Deschenaux and Gulcehre, 2026 ) and ELF ( Hu et al., 2026 ) . These span three distinct continuous
paradigms, namely one-hot embeddings, spherical embeddings, and latent
embeddings, underscoring the broad applicability of our method and showing
that it is not tied to the choice of input representation. We first
describe the experimental setup ( Sec. 4.1 ). We then present
unconditional text generation results on OWT with FLM and ELF ( Sec. 4.2 ), followed by math reasoning results on GSM8K ( Cobbe et al., 2021 ) with S-FLM ( Sec. 4.3 ). Finally, we
analyze the effect of the noise level strategy and the choice of distilled layers in ( Sec. 4.4 ).

blocks.en: 5 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 5 结论

blocks.en:
In this work, we introduced SERF , a simple self-regularization
framework for continuous diffusion language models. Building on the
observation that an EMA teacher evaluated at a cleaner point on the same
interpolation path provides informative targets for a noisier student, SERF augments the standard training objective with a noisy-to-clean
self-distillation loss that requires no external models and leaves the
architecture and sampling procedure unchanged. We studied two
instantiations: SERF-L , which distills intermediate hidden
representations, and SERF-P , which distills output token
distributions, together with its early-layer variant SERF-P k .
For both latent and distribution targets, supervising early student layers
proved most effective. Across three baselines, SERF consistently
improves generation quality. On OWT , SERF-L and SERF-P k match or exceed FLM trained for 1 1 M steps using
roughly a tenth of the training budget, with gains that persist in the
few-step regime; on GSM8K , SERF improves the accuracy of S-FLM and outperforms prior continuous diffusion language models.
Overall, these results suggest that the denoising trajectory is a rich source
of self-supervision for language, and that simple self-distillation along it
is an effective and practical way to exploit it.

blocks.en: Appendix D Limitations and Future Work
blocks.zh: 附录D 限制和今后的工作

blocks.en: Our method is currently developed and evaluated for continuous flow-based language models. Extending the framework to discrete diffusion language models ( Sahoo et al., 2024 ; Schiff et al., 2024 ) represents a promising direction for future work. Since discrete diffusion models follow different corruption and denoising dynamics than continuous flows, adapting the teacher supervision mechanism may require additional design considerations. We view this as an opportunity to further generalize our framework and broaden its applicability.
blocks.zh: 我们的方法目前正在开发和评价,以便采用基于连续流量的语言模式。 将框架扩大到分散的传播语言模型(Sahoo等人,2024年;Schiff等人,2024年)是未来工作的一个有希望的方向。 由于分散的传播模式跟随不同的腐败和诋毁动态而不是连续流动,调整教师监督机制可能需要额外的设计考虑。 我们认为,这是进一步概括我们的框架并扩大其适用性的一次机会。
